experiment: Operational temporal-shape candidate held-out GIS review
selection: Three unseen objects from strict selected/future persistent, loose-only/future persistent, loose selected/no future support, future persistent rejected as elongated, and future persistent rejected as >=5 ha.
limits: This is a mechanism-stratified review and cannot estimate population accuracy.
Future absence may indicate drying rather than a false positive.
Future persistence may repeat a systematic error rather than prove water.
No candidate is restored and no model output is changed.
